object.attr: Retrying does not fix a missing ANT+ Plugins Service, a missing ANT+ adapter or a sensor without the Heart Rate Measurement characteristic. The matching connection status stays shown. Bluetooth unavailable is not in this list because PACE-SRS-84 covers it. Basis: as implemented.
object.description: When a connection attempt fails with plugin missing, no ANT+ adapter or sensor error, the app shall make no further connection attempts in the session.
